events.body: Agent: I can't see any rebooking on here, sir. Caller: The last one told me it was rebooked for the 21st. Agent: I can't see that. As it's now past the delivery date, what you'd need to do is file a claim for the parcel. Caller: A claim. For the parcel. It's on my kitchen table. Agent: That's the process once the delivery date has passed.

File a CLAIM. For a box that is sitting on my kitchen table because you useless bloody shower never came to get it. What the hell am I claiming for, the table? One of you says it's rebooked, the next one says there's no rebooking, the third one wants me to fill in a lost parcel form for something I am LOOKING AT. I paid the premium rate. PREMIUM. For the 18th. It is the 23rd. My buyer thinks I'm a con man. I want that premium back and I want an actual van at my actual door, and I want someone to tell me which of your lot is lying about the rebooking. Sorry. I'm sorry for the language, I know it isn't you personally. I'm just at the end of it.
